item.title: Man charged in connection with death of girl on camping trip in Scotland
item.summary: Police say man, 35, was known to nine-year-old girl, who was found seriously injured on industrial estate in Arbroath A man has been charged in connection with the death of a nine-year-old girl on a family camping trip in Scotland. The girl, from West Yorkshire, was found seriously injured just after midnight on Monday morning at the Elliot industrial estate in Arbroath, Angus. Continue reading...
